methods.name: Foreign individual: documented current-account purchase, then wire
methods.name_zh: 境外个人经常项目合法人民币收入购汇 + 跨境电汇
methods.basis: SAFE Tianjin 2024 Q&A case (9), Current-Account FX Business Guidelines (2020) art. 59
methods.fee_source: BOC personal e-banking tariff — 1‰, min ¥50, max ¥260, cable ¥150
methods.verdict: RECOMMENDED when the RMB is lawful current-account income and the bank treats you as 境外个人.
methods.quota: No annual amount limit in art. 59; the bank audits the source of the RMB on every payment.
methods.feasibility: Feasible in one payment if the source file is complete.

methods.name: Same route, bought with BOC Global Smart Remittance (中银全球智汇)
methods.name_zh: 中银全球智汇（汇款进度跟踪、全额到账可选）
methods.verdict: Optional premium. Costs more than M01; buys tracking and message passthrough, not a lower charge.

methods.name: M01 plus full-amount credit (全额到账), worst case USD 25
methods.name_zh: 普通电汇 + 全额到账（收款行未在中行纽约分行开户）
methods.fee_source: BOC personal tariff + USD 25 flat full-amount-credit charge
methods.verdict: Best value when you need a known net figure: turns an unpublished correspondent deduction into a published USD 25.
methods.feasibility: Feasible in one payment. If the receiving bank holds an account with BOC New York, the charge is USD 15 instead of USD 25.

methods.name: Domestic individual: USD 50,000 annual convenience amount
methods.name_zh: 境内个人年度便利化额度内购汇（每人每年等值5万美元）
methods.basis: SAFE Ningxia 2022 Q&A; SAFE Tianjin 2024 Q&A case (9)
methods.fee_source: BOC personal e-banking tariff — 1‰, min ¥50, max ¥260, cable ¥150
methods.verdict: Cheapest paperwork, but the amount is the binding constraint, not the cost.
methods.quota: USD 50,000 equivalent per person per year. ID only; no source documents.
methods.feasibility: Feasible in one payment only up to USD 50,000. Above that it takes one year per USD 50,000 of balance.

methods.name: Emigrant property transfer (移民财产转移)
methods.name_zh: 移民财产对外转移售付汇
methods.basis: PBC Announcement [2004] No. 16, State Council Gazette 2005 No. 22
methods.fee_source: BOC personal e-banking tariff — 1‰, min ¥50, max ¥260, cable ¥150
methods.verdict: The only no-ceiling capital route for a naturalised citizen, and the one that requires a cancelled PRC household registration plus a tax certificate.
methods.quota: No amount ceiling. Art. 10: up to RMB 500,000 decided by the local SAFE branch; above that, SAFE head office. Art. 6: one application for the whole balance, remitted in stages.
methods.feasibility: Feasible, but not in one payment above RMB 200,000 (see the staging column in cost-steps.html).

methods.name: Inheritance transfer (继承财产转移)
methods.name_zh: 继承财产对外转移售付汇
methods.fee_source: BOC personal e-banking tariff — 1‰, min ¥50, max ¥260, cable ¥150
methods.verdict: Applies only if the money is an inheritance from a PRC decedent. One application covers all property from the same decedent.
methods.quota: No amount ceiling. Same RMB 500,000 approval split as M05.
methods.feasibility: Feasible; documentary load is the constraint, not cost.

methods.name: Balance already held in USD in an FX savings account
methods.name_zh: 外汇储蓄账户内外汇直接汇出
methods.basis: SAFE Tianjin 2024 Q&A (三), Guidelines art. 64; 实施细则 art. 15
methods.fee_source: BOC personal e-banking tariff — 1‰, min ¥50, max ¥260, cable ¥150
methods.verdict: Zero FX margin because no conversion happens. Only useful if the balance is already USD, which the premise says it is not.
methods.quota: Remittance on ID up to USD 50,000/day; above that, transaction documents.

methods.name: Traveller's cash and overseas card withdrawal
methods.name_zh: 携带外币现钞出境 / 银行卡境外提取现金
methods.basis: SAFE guidance on cash carry; SAFE card-withdrawal notice
methods.fee_source: BOC cash selling rate 669.19/100 (same as spot on 2026-11-09); no wire fee
methods.verdict: Not a mechanism for a balance of this size. Reporting duties on the US side attach at USD 10,000.
methods.quota: RMB 100,000 per person per year of overseas cash withdrawal; separate cash-carry limits at the border.
methods.feasibility: Cap-limited far below the range in this table; shown only to price it, not to recommend it.
